title: 10 Best Cistus Clusii Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Cistus clusii are teas, decoctions, tinctures, capsules, and oils, each offering unique benefits for health and wellness. Teas made from dried leaves and flowers are commonly consumed to support respiratory and immune health. Decoctions involve boiling the plant material to extract its active compounds, enhancing its potency. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb, often used for targeted therapeutic effects. Capsules offer a convenient and standardized method of consumption, while oils are used topically for skin conditions and muscle pain.
